name: probe-a4e8aa
purpose: One-page guestbook: visitors type a short message and see the wall of messages, newest first. No accounts, no commerce — just write and read.

workflows.name: Leave a message
workflows.description: Visitor types a name (optional) and a short message, submits, and it appears on the wall.

workflows.name: Read the wall
workflows.description: Visitor sees all messages, newest first, on the single page.

seed_demo: A few short welcome messages so the wall is not empty on first load.
